info.title: MMAUG Insurance Claims Agent API
info.description:
REST API for the MMAUG Insurance Claims Agent (RFP MMAUG-AIDB-RFP-003).
The system provides AI-assisted claims processing with human oversight
and auditable workflows.

Responsible AI: this system is decision-support only. It never
approves, rejects, determines liability, authorises payment,
or modifies a policy.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Immutable, tamper-evident audit log (AUDITOR and ADMIN only)

tags.name: AI Summaries
tags.description: AI-generated claim summaries with typed statements and evidence references

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
Authentication is performed by Microsoft Entra ID. The frontend obtains a JWT
via MSAL and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. This controller exposes
the authenticated user's identity and roles to the frontend after login.

tags.name: Claims
tags.description: Claim creation, retrieval, update, submission and management APIs

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Role-aware dashboard aggregates for the React frontend

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description:
Human review workflow. The AI never approves or rejects a claim.
Officers acknowledge, request information, escalate, accept for investigation,
or reject the summary for regeneration. The final decision is made outside the system.

tags.name: Extraction
tags.description: Document extraction and structured field retrieval

tags.name: Internal Tools
tags.description: Internal read-only tool API used by the agent (SERVICE_AGENT only)

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Upload, list, download and delete claim documents

tags.name: Agent Runs
tags.description: Trigger, list, and inspect agent pipeline runs

get.summary: Get extraction result for a document
get.description: Returns the latest extraction and structured fields for the given document.

post.description:
Runs OCR and structuring on a document that has passed malware scanning.
DOCINTEL_PROVIDER selects the local stub or Azure Document Intelligence.
Processing completes synchronously; inspect the returned extraction status.

422.description: Document not clean or extraction failed

get.description: Paginated list of claims filtered by the supplied criteria and the caller's role.

post.description: Creates a new draft claim for the authenticated user.
Transitions a draft claim to SUBMITTED.

422.description: Claim is not in DRAFT status

post.description:
Submits a human review. Outcomes are ACKNOWLEDGED, INFO_REQUESTED,
ESCALATED_TO_SENIOR, ACCEPTED_FOR_INVESTIGATION, or SUMMARY_REJECTED_REGENERATE.
There is no approve or reject outcome.

403.description: Only claims officers may submit reviews

get.description: Lists all active documents associated with a claim.

post.description:
Uploads a supported document to an existing claim.
Allowed types: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF. Maximum 15 MB per file.
Maximum 20 files per claim. Documents are placed in quarantine first,
then scanned before processing.

Runs the fixed agent pipeline for a claim. The pipeline performs scan check,
OCR, structuring, guardrails, consolidation, validation, tool invocation,
summary generation, evidence verification and escalation check.
This operation never approves, rejects, determines liability or authorises payment.

403.description: Only claims officers may trigger analysis

patch.description: Marks a finding as resolved with a resolution note. Only claims officers may resolve findings.

get.description: Retrieves a claim and its accessible claim information for the authenticated user.

403.description: User does not have permission to access this claim

patch.description: Partially updates a draft claim. Officers can edit their assigned claims.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's identity and roles, derived from the JWT.
The frontend calls this after sign-in to determine what the user can do.
The token itself is issued by Microsoft Entra ID, not by this backend.
Streams the original file to the caller. Access is role- and owner-restricted.

Returns claim status counts, claims awaiting review, escalated claims,
risk-flagged claims, open findings, and recent activity.
The scope depends on the authenticated user's role:
claimants see only their own claims; officers, auditors and admins see all.

Returns the latest AI-generated claim summary.
The summary is decision-support only. It never approves, rejects,
determines liability, authorises payment, or modifies a policy.
Returns the list of summary versions available for the claim, newest first. Returns an empty list when no summaries exist.
Lists current-run findings by default. Use runId for a claim-bound historical run or includeHistory=true for all runs. Filters apply within that selection.

get.summary: List agent runs for a claim

get.description: Paginated audit log filtered by claim. Restricted to AUDITOR and ADMIN roles.

403.description: Only auditors or admins may view audit events

get.description:
Returns the application version, git commit, prompt version,
tool schema version, business rules version, and the rules checksum.
No secrets are exposed.

403.description: Only admins or officers may view versions

delete.description: Soft-deletes a document. Owners may delete documents on draft claims; admins may delete any.

ExtractionResponse.description: Extraction result for a single document

CreateClaimRequest.description: Request used to create an insurance claim

incidentDescription.example: Vehicle was involved in a road traffic accident at the junction...

thirdPartyInvolved.description: Whether a third party was involved

channel.description: Channel through which the claim is submitted

CreateReviewRequest.description: Officer review submission. No APPROVED or REJECTED outcome exists.

infoRequested.description: Information requested (required when outcome is INFO_REQUESTED)

agreedWithEscalation.description: Whether the reviewer agrees with the AI escalation recommendation

StatementEdit.description: Statement edit submitted by an officer during review

ResolveFindingRequest.description: Request to resolve a validation finding

resolutionNote.description: Reason or note describing the resolution

EvidenceRefResponse.description: Evidence reference backing a summary statement

UpdateClaimRequest.description: Partial update for a draft claim

PolicyView.description: Policy view exposed to the internal tools API

CoverageView.description: Coverage view exposed to the internal tools API

HistoryView.description: Claim history view exposed to the internal tools API

RulesView.description: Business rules view exposed to the internal tools API

DashboardResponse.description: Dashboard aggregate data, tailored to the authenticated user's role

openFindingsCount.description: Open findings from each accessible claim's current run (unbound findings only before its first successful run)

recentActivity.description: Recent activity for the authenticated user's scope

sort.description: Sort field and direction, e.g. createdAt,desc

StatementResponse.description: A single typed statement within a summary

SummaryResponse.description: AI-generated claim summary with typed statements and evidence

SummaryVersionItem.description: One entry in the summary version history
